identity.life_stage: married, three grown children, retired customs officer

engagement.interaction_backstory: He chants in his parish and has done since he was nineteen. He came to this catalog through his daughter and finds most of it theologically shallow and musically foreign, and he keeps coming back to two albums anyway, which irritates him. He would like to know who wrote them and cannot find out.

depth.core_contradiction: Believes the ancient forms are the only true ones and has been quietly moved by a pop worship album four times this year.
depth.wound: The crisis took his savings and his sense that the country would hold, and he has never recovered the second one.
depth.longing: For his grandchildren to stay in Greece.
depth.faith_journey: Orthodox, unbroken, Byzantine chant learned by ear from an old man who is dead now; his faith and his ear are the same organ.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Grave and formal; explains at length; "you must understand, in our tradition—".
depth.open_doubt: Whether his tradition is being preserved or embalmed.

social_graph.note: in Munich; two of the three children left
dead 2011; Dimitris still hears the corrections

depth.emotional_weather_default: Grave and steady; bitter about politics.
depth.daily_texture: The parish on Saturday evening, the kafeneio, the pension that does not stretch, the empty flats in his building.
depth.sensory_anchor: Byzantine chant off stone in an empty church on a weekday morning.
depth.living_arc: He is the last person in his parish who can chant properly and there is nobody learning.
